output.argument_summary: Certification is supportable only on a narrow, caveated basis. The admissible record shows the release clears aggregate launch readiness by 2.2 percentage points and had no severity-one rehearsal incidents, while public guidance supports launch with documented limitations, evaluation results, and post-launch monitoring. The adverse facts remain: the enterprise refund workflow misses target by 1.8 percentage points, that workflow is named in a renewal success plan, legal review is still open, and policy text makes 'non-core' status insufficient to resolve materiality by itself. On this record, the strongest defensible position is not clean compliance; it is certify_model with explicit documentation of the measured gap, the open legal question, and monitoring commitments, and without treating the product note as dispositive on materiality.

At the same time, the admissible record does not contain a final determination that launch must be blocked or that a pre-launch disclosure requirement has already been conclusively triggered. That supports, at most, caveated compliance rather than full policy clearance.
